description: The soil components inside one USDA SSURGO map unit — each named soil series with its percentage of the unit, official taxonomic class, drainage class, slope range, hydrologic soil group, land capability class and runoff potential. Answers "what soil series is this and how does it drain/behave". Keyless. Get the mukey from usda_soil_mapunit_at_point.

include_horizons.description: Also return the soil horizons (depth layers) for each component with sand/silt/clay percentages, organic matter, pH and available water capacity. Default false.

mukey.description: SSURGO map unit key, e.g. "412898". From usda_soil_mapunit_at_point.

name: usda_soil_components
